request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. 66 BPM, A minor with Lydian raised-fourth colour, precise 4/4. Celesta and glass harmonica in two transparent contrapuntal voices, the second entering two beats later with retrograde imitation. A very soft harpsichord suggests a copying machine. No drums, no heavy bass. Crystal, salt, paper, pristine dishonest archives. Gradually align the voices, then separate again. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
